cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: We Needed the Break
cards.instruction: Frame a rupture, absence, or failed connection as a healthy decision that ultimately helped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Coffee on Sunday? That year apart was good for us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You used to insist we spend every Saturday together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Exactly. We needed the break to stop treating a free afternoon as proof of love.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've booked pottery this Sunday too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then coffee Monday. Look at us: a whole extra day apart without an emergency meeting.

mechanism: A grants more independent time as if administering the healthy lesson of a year apart, controlling the terms of a supposedly freer connection.
confusable: D65 calls loss a deliberate concession from strength; D89 frames relationship rupture as something healthy that helped.
comparison: Rescheduling coffee around pottery differs from reducing a family lunch after a shouting reunion.
seedUse: Use D89-a former Saturday demands and B Sunday class; A can approve flexibility while treating it as proof the break helped.
